section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content: WAKE TF UP respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and Slovak Act No. 18/2018 Coll. on Personal Data Protection. This policy informs you about how we process your personal data when you visit our website or make a purchase.

section3.title: 3. Data We Collect
section3.intro: We may collect, use, store, and transfer different types of personal data:

personal.title: Identity Data
personal.content: first name, last name, email, phone number

order.content: delivery address, billing details (company ID, tax ID, VAT ID for business purchases)

section4.item2: Communicate with you about orders and delivery

section6.intro: We may share your data with the following parties:

shipping.title: Shipping Companies
shipping.content: Packeta, DPD (only data necessary for delivery)

section7.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
section7.intro: Under GDPR, you have the following rights:
section7.access: Right to access your personal data
section7.rectification: Right to rectification of inaccurate data
section7.erasure: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten')
section7.complaint: Right to lodge a complaint with Slovak Data Protection Authority (dataprotection.gov.sk)

section8.title: 8. Data Retention
section8.content: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. Order data is retained for at least 10 years in accordance with accounting regulations. Marketing consents remain valid until withdrawn.

section9.title: 9. Security
section9.content: We have implemented appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. We use SSL/TLS encryption, secure servers, and regularly update our security protocols.

section10.title: 10. Cookies
section10.content:
Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your user experience. Cookies are divided into these categories:

Essential Cookies: Required for website functionality (login, cart, security). These cookies are always active and cannot be disabled.

Analytics Cookies: We use our own analytics tracking cookies to monitor product clicks and views. These cookies are activated ONLY WITH YOUR CONSENT through the cookie banner. Without your consent, no analytics data is shared with us.

Marketing Cookies: We do not use third-party marketing cookies from external services. Marketing cookies are only available with YOUR EXPLICIT CONSENT.

You can disable all cookies other than essential ones in the banner settings. Your consent (or refusal) is saved to localStorage. You can change it at any time by accessing the cookie settings in the bottom left corner of the website.

section11.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
section11.content: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by email or website notice. We recommend checking this page regularly.

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content: These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern the rights and obligations of the seller and buyer when purchasing goods through the online store at waketfup.com. These Terms are issued in accordance with Slovak Civil Code Act No. 40/1964 Coll., Consumer Protection Act No. 250/2007 Coll., and Distance Selling Act No. 102/2014 Coll.

section2.title: 2. Definitions
section2.seller: Seller: WAKE TF UP, Patrik Bielčik, Company ID: 56698585, Tax ID: 1127876057, registered at Jedľová 319/33, 010 04 Žilina, Slovakia
section2.buyer: Buyer: individual or legal entity entering into a purchase contract
section2.goods: Goods: streetwear clothing from recycled materials presented in the online store
section2.contract: Purchase Contract: distance contract between seller and buyer

section3.title: 3. Account Registration
section3.content: Buyer may create a user account by registration. During registration, the buyer must provide truthful information. Buyer is responsible for protecting their password. Buyer may cancel their account at any time.

section4.title: 4. Orders and Contract Formation
section4.step1: Buyer adds goods to cart and proceeds to checkout
section4.step2: Fills in delivery and billing details
section4.step3: Selects delivery method and pays for the order
section4.step4: Purchase contract is concluded by submitting the order and its confirmation by seller via email

section5.title: 5. Prices and Payment Terms
section5.item1: All prices are stated in EUR including VAT
section5.item2: Prices are valid at the time of order submission
section5.item3: Delivery cost is added to the goods price according to selected delivery method
section5.item4: Payment is possible by online payment card or bank transfer

section6.title: 6. Delivery
section6.content: We deliver goods through contracted carriers (Packeta, DPD). Standard delivery time is 3-5 business days. You will be notified by email about shipment with tracking number. Ownership of goods transfers to buyer upon receipt and full payment of purchase price.

section7.title: 7. Right of Withdrawal (Slovak Act No. 102/2014)
section7.intro: Buyer has the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days from receipt of goods without stating a reason.
section7.form: Form: you can use our form or send an email
section7.return: Goods return: within 14 days of withdrawal, in original packaging, unused
section7.refund: Money return: within 14 days from receipt of returned goods
section7.exception2: Goods that have been opened and cannot be returned for hygienic reasons
section7.exception3: Limited edition items (if marked as non-returnable)

section8.title: 8. Warranty and Complaints
section8.content: Goods are covered by a 24-month legal warranty. You can file a complaint at the seller's address or by email at complaints@waketfup.com. We will process the complaint within 30 days. Rights from liability for defects are governed by the Civil Code and Consumer Protection Act.

section9.title: 9. Intellectual Property
section9.content: All website content (design, photos, texts, logos) is protected by copyright and is the property of the seller. Any use without written consent is prohibited.

section10.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
section10.content: Seller is not liable for damage caused by improper use of goods or failure to follow care instructions. Seller is not responsible for delivery delays caused by carrier or force majeure.

section11.title: 11. Dispute Resolution
section11.content:
If a dispute arises between seller and buyer, we will attempt extrajudicial resolution. Buyer has the right to contact alternative dispute resolution body:

Slovak Trade Inspection
Prievozská 32, 827 99 Bratislava
Tel: 02/58 27 21 72
www.soi.sk

EU Online Dispute Resolution Platform: ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr

section12.title: 12. Final Provisions
section12.content: These Terms become effective on January 16, 2026. Seller reserves the right to change these Terms. Current Terms are always available on this page. Relationships not covered by Terms are governed by Slovak law.
